name: loopd-repos-reload
about: loopd reads --repos-file again on SIGHUP (#189), with no restart: before the reload `/loop add pantry: ...` sets no repo and the CLI's --repo pantry is refused. An invalid file is refused and the repos stay (the mobile alias still resolves). After a valid one that adds sandbox/extra with the alias pantry, the Slack add and the CLI both resolve it.

steps.text:
sandbox/extra: pantry
sandbox/jarvis-node-mobile: mobile, node app
